drivingQuestion: Does Grace After Meals require a cup of wine?

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב חָנָן לְרָבָא: שְׁמַע מִינַּהּ בִּרְכַּת הַמָּזוֹן טְעוּנָה כּוֹס. אֲמַר לֵיהּ: אַרְבַּע כָּסֵי תִּיקְּנוּ רַבָּנַן דֶּרֶךְ חֵירוּת, כֹּל חַד וְחַד נַעֲבֵיד בֵּיהּ מִצְוָה.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» «Ran Ḥanan said to Rava:» Since the mishna states that Grace After Meals must be recited over the third cup, «learn from it» that Grace After Meals «requires a cup» of wine. Rava «said to him:» This is no proof, for although «the Sages instituted» the drinking of «four cups in the manner of freedom,» once the four cups are in place, with «each and every one» of them «we will perform a mitzva,» despite the fact that they were not originally instituted for this purpose. After the Sages instituted these four cups, they attached a special mitzva to each one. However, this does not prove that there is an obligation to recite Grace After Meals over a cup of wine during the rest of the year.
